title: Hawthorn Bancshares, Inc. Expands Missouri Presence with Acquisition of FSC Bancshares, Inc.
summary: JEFFERSON CITY, Mo., April 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Hawthorn Bancshares, Inc. (“Hawthorn”) (NASDAQ: HWBK), the holding company for Hawthorn Bank, and FSC Bancshares, Inc. (“FSC”), the holding company for Farmers State Bank, today jointly announced the signing of an Agreement and Plan of Reorganization (the “Agreement”) pursuant to which Hawthorn will acquire FSC in a cash and stock transaction valued at approximately $28.3 million in the aggregate, based on Hawthorn’s closing stock price of $34.57 as of April 28, 2026. Based on financial data as of March 31, 2026, the combined company is expected to have total assets of approximately $2.2 billion, total loans of approximately $1.7 billion, and total deposits of approximately $1.9 billion.
